metadata.description: Official Infisical skills for AI coding agents — correct SDK usage, auth methods, secret syncs, dynamic secrets, agent config, and more.

plugins.name: infisical-setup
plugins.description: Interactive setup guide for integrating Infisical into your projects — CLI, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, SDKs, and machine identity auth.

plugins.name: infisical-secret-syncs
plugins.description: Guide for configuring Infisical Secret Syncs to push secrets to all 48 supported destinations including AWS Secrets Manager, GCP Secret Manager, Azure Key Vault, GitHub, Vercel, HashiCorp Vault, Snowflake, and Databricks.

plugins.name: infisical-dynamic-secrets
plugins.description: Guide for configuring Infisical Dynamic Secrets — on-demand, short-lived credentials for databases, cloud IAM, SSH, and Kubernetes across all 30 providers.

plugins.name: infisical-agent
plugins.description: Guide for configuring the Infisical Agent — a client daemon that manages auth token lifecycle and renders secrets to files via Go templates.

plugins.name: infisical-terraform
plugins.description: Guide for using the Infisical Terraform Provider — HCL resources, ephemeral secrets, data sources, project roles, and Terraform Cloud OIDC integration.

plugins.name: infisical-api
plugins.description: Guide for the Infisical REST API — authentication, secrets CRUD (v4), projects, identities, pagination, and rate limits.

plugins.name: infisical-self-host
plugins.description: Guide for self-hosting Infisical — Docker, Kubernetes Helm, environment variables, ENCRYPTION_KEY setup, FIPS compliance, scaling, and production hardening.
